name: sortable-list
title: Sortable List
description: A stacked task list where each row has a checkbox, a number and a label; rows can be dragged to reorder, and checking one shrinks it and reveals a delete button.
use: Users need to set the order of a short task or playlist list themselves, not just tick items off.
avoid: The list is long; dragging every row is slow and there is no search or keyboard reorder.
a11y: Reordering is pointer-only; checkboxes work from the keyboard but their label says Mark to delete for a completion action. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Five dark rounded rows stack with small gaps on black. Each row holds a round outline checkbox, a faint order number and light grey text; a checked row narrows and shows a red trash icon.
behaves: Dragging a row lifts it while the others spring aside; checking the box turns the label red, then shrinks the row and slides a delete button in from the side.
customise: items and setItems drive the rows while renderItem controls each row's markup; drag, collapse and delete animations are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A handful of rows with layout springs that run only while dragging or toggling.
